what: CrowdStrike sells Falcon, a cloud platform that protects laptops, servers, cloud workloads and identities from hackers. Customers pay a subscription per module.
customers: Companies of all sizes and government agencies.
money: Falcon modules sold per device or user
moat: A single lightweight agent, a huge pool of threat data that improves detection, and customers adding more modules over time.
opportunities: Revenue grew about 22% last year and about 29% a year over three years
Gross margin of 75% with cash of $5 billion against little debt
Customers keep adding modules, which raises revenue per customer without new wins
watch: Annual recurring revenue growth and module adoption per customer.
